title: Track and verify downstream reuse events
context: Outcomes are measured by real downstream reuse, so this task tracks and verifies external reuse events with externally verifiable evidence. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access (PMC OA Subset) / aggregate / de-identified data only; no identifiable patient data; no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. No self-reported reuse counts.
objective: Track and verify downstream reuse events of the corpus with externally verifiable evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: >= 1 verifiable external/downstream reuse event recorded (e.g. an ewsr1-fli1-knowledge-graph commit ingesting the corpus, a citation, or written consumer confirmation).
Each event links to externally verifiable evidence (no self-reported reuse).
